title: 2. Check conclusions one by one3. Do not assume anything extra

blocks.content:
Solved Example:

Statements:

All soldiers are disciplined.

Some disciplined are officers.



Conclusion:

Some soldiers are officers.

Logic:

Not necessarily true (no direct link)

Answer:

Conclusion does not follow

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Evaluate each given conclusion independently against the provided statement.
Strictly refrain from assuming facts or drawing from external real-world knowledge outside the text.
Treat the statements given in the question as absolute truth, even if they deviate from established facts.
Examiners often trick candidates by including real-world facts that are not explicitly stated in the premise.
Conclusions must be tested individually; one conclusion's validity should not automatically determine another's unless explicit logic demands it.

Practice Questions (Syllogism):



Q4.

Statements:

All dogs are animals.

All animals are living beings.



Conclusions:

I. All dogs are living beings

II. Some animals are dogs



A. Only I follows

B. Only II follows

C. Both follow

D. Neither follows



Q5.

Statements:

All pens are papers.



Conclusions:

II. All books are papers



A. Only I
